title: Dates and strings: agreement with lubridate and stringr
label: lubridate and stringr
checked: Date parsing, date parts, rounding, periods, time zones, and stringr pattern, padding, truncation, and case functions in mutate(), on every backend.

inputs.name: date and string cases
inputs.detail: A 5-row table of dates, datetimes, and text with NA, plus per-case vectors, defined in tests/Support/LubridateStringrCases.php and tests/r/lubridate_stringr.R

comparison.applies_to: Dates compare as YYYY-MM-DD and datetimes as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS +hhmm" in their time zone. Numbers are rounded to 9 decimal places with PHP round(), then compared exactly. NA must be NA in the same positions.
As rounded, and the verb must run in Polars with no fallback to a DataFrame, except str_to_title(), which needs ICU word breaks and runs on a DataFrame.

known_differences: On SQL databases, a function with no faithful SQL translation runs in memory after the query. Those cases are compared the same way.
reproduce: PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres" PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306" PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root php vendor/bin/pest tests/LubridateStringrTest.php tests/SqlTest.php
description: The fixtures were regenerated with these R versions on 2026-11-01 and were byte-identical to the committed files.
